SessionPolicy.description:
Session limits. In TS every field except `hard_cap_min` is a fixed literal
(55, 60, 30, 5, 15, 10, 120, 5); `hard_cap_min` is 60..480, default 240.

Deserializing rejects any other value (#259), so a `SessionPolicy` read from JSON is
always valid. A value built in Rust can be checked with [`SessionPolicy::validate`].

RecordingSettingsPatch.description:
A partial `RecordingSettings` for `recording_settings_write`. An absent field keeps its
value. A value cannot be cleared to `null`: the user picks another one.

recording_start.description:

cloud call of this recording, including after `recording_stop`. `instructions`: for
this recording only. Absent: the Settings preset.
recording_start.title: RecordingStartArgs

recording_storage_probe.description:
`recording_storage_probe` (ADR 0103): probes `GET /api/2.0/fs/directories` on the
home profile host. Rust never picks a profile: the brain sends the home profile of
`src/brain/home-profile.ts` on every cloud-bound recording command.
recording_storage_probe.title: RecordingStorageProbeArgs

recording_volume_create.description:
`recording_volume_create` (ADR 0103): Bottle creates the managed volume `bottle_audio`
in `catalog.schema`, after the user confirmed in Settings. `profile`: the home profile
(the brain never lets Rust pick one).
recording_volume_create.title: RecordingVolumeCreateArgs
